name: Benton Ridge RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m and 180 m frames) at 38.3155,-93.2951: rows of RVs on gravel loops in oak woods; two small catch-and-release ponds, the nearest units 25-40 m back from the southern one behind trees and rough grass, with no open apron to the water; default down - not waterfront

name: Heit's Point Lutheran Camp
evidence: satellite (Esri, 800 m and 900 m frames) at 38.2733,-93.2083: retreat center and cabins on wooded hills above the Lake of the Ozarks shore (80 mile marker); no RV pad row visible at the water's edge - the camp names separate 'Lake Front' cabins, and the RV sites could not be placed under the canopy; default down - not waterfront

name: Black Silo RV Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 40.0739,-93.5676: a gravel lot of pull-throughs behind the winery building, among fields and a vineyard; farm ponds 100+ m off across pasture; not waterfront
